predator.name: Alpha Sickle
predator.description: Once wielded by the legendary "Alpha Predator", this Sickle was used in the uprising of the Hish against their cruel Amengi rulers thousands of years ago

predator.name: Battle Axe
predator.description: Wielded by the Viking Predator of the north, this powerful two-handed battle axe was forged for devastating close range attacks against ferocious Norsemen. The secondary attack provides a heavy overhead swing with increased damage to any prey it finds. Few would ever look upon this blade without it cleaving their skull.

predator.name: Norse Hammer
predator.description: Wielded by the ferocious Valkyrie Predator of the north, this mighty two-handed Norse Hammer was forged for dealing crippling close range damage against any Norsemen that would stand in her way. The secondary attack provides a heavy overhead swing with increased damage to any prey unfortunate enough to stand in her path.

predator.name: The Eye of Ra
predator.description: As if harnessing its power from the sun itself, this gleaming variant of the Handheld Plasma Caster fires powerful, concentrated projectiles with less arc and faster traveling speed.  However, it has a slower firing rate and a smaller clip capacity.

predator.name: Katana
predator.description: This retractable single edged sword was used in many hunts throughout ancient earth. The long blade produces heavy two handed attacks against prey. This melee weapon has Primary and Secondary combo attacks, both of which cause temporary bleeding to prey.

predator.name: Dual Swords
predator.description: Like fierce torrents of dancing winds, the Dual Blades allow the user to quickly cut through multiple foes with each swing of each blade.  Its secondary attack allows the user to lunge towards targets with a crossing horizontal slash that cannot be parried but has a longer recovery time.

predator.name: Wrist Launcher
predator.description: Thermal projectile launcher built into the City Hunter's left wrist gauntlet

predator.name: Shield
predator.description: An expandable shield that is worn on the left arm. Upon expanding, soaks up any incoming damage to avoid heavy barrages of gunfire or other attacks. If the shield absorbs too much damage, it can overload your energy.

predator.name: Crossbolt Gun
predator.description: Fires a fast moving, guided Crossbolt Arrow that pierces through targets, causing massive damage. Arrows must be retrieved.

predator.name: Trident
predator.description: A specially crafted three-pronged spear that slightly sacrifices melee and throwing power for superior handling and portability, allowing the user to carry multiple Tridents at once.

predator.name: War Club
predator.description: Ceremonial bladed war club used by Yautja who prefer close melee combat. This club will pack a heavy punch which disorients victims and has a final swing that cannot be parried.

predator.name: Combistick
predator.description: A retractible spear and one of the more popular choices of Yautja hunters. Powerful, wide swathed melee attacks allow for easily dispatching groups of prey. The Combistick may also be hurled through the air, doing massive amounts of damage and pinning lesser prey to surfaces

predator.name: Hand Held Plasma Caster
predator.description: An ammo based hand held version of the plasma caster that produces a multi-shot fractured plasma projectile. Effective at close ranges

predator.name: Net Gun
predator.description: Shoots a large net projectile at a limited range. Upon trapping or pinning a victim, this net will begin to constrict, dealing damage while they are vulnerable. This weapon contains limited uses

predator.name: Yautja Bow
predator.description: A powerful, collapsable bow made from some of the rarest materials on Yautja Prime. Charging the bow will increase arrow velocity and damage. Arrows fired from this bow will slow live targets, pin lesser prey, and can be retrieved for re-use.

predator.name: Smart Disc
predator.description: A sharp bladed disc held in hand. Can be used for quick, effective melee attacks or thrown and piloted via the wrist computer. Impacts with prey while piloting deals massive damage

predator.name: Elder Sword
predator.description: An ancient Yautja blade passed down from elders to aide young bloods during their hunts. This melee weapon produces several attacks in quick succession.

fireteam.name: Hammerhead
fireteam.description: Well balanced, all purpose assault rifle with an underbarrel grenade launcher

fireteam.name: NRV-E
fireteam.description: This heavily customized sniper rifle has a number of advanced modifications that put it into a field of its own. Incorporating Predator Technology, its unique rounds are devastating to their target and the surrounding area.

fireteam.name: Plasma Rifle Prototype
fireteam.description: Fresh out of the OWLF’s R&D department, this projectile-based weapon fires a concentrated, explosive, plasma-energy round at a high velocity. Fully automatic, energy-based, with a venting process to reload the plasma shots.

fireteam.name: PDL
fireteam.description: Using modified alien technology, the OWLF was able to retrofit a grenade launcher to fire proximity sensing mines. This new tool allows them to turn the tables on a Predator and become the hunter.

fireteam.name: B34S-T
fireteam.description: Purpose built as an anti-armor weapon, this rocket propelled grenade launcher quickly became a favorite of the OWLF after a mission in Thailand proved its effectiveness against predators.

fireteam.name: O.W.L.F. PIT BULL
fireteam.description: A special bull-pup assault rifle designed and created by O.W.L.F. researchers for use in the field

fireteam.name: Mercenary ('87)
fireteam.description: The original weapon wielded by Alan "Dutch" Schaefer during the Val Verde Incident of 1987. This fully automatic rifle packs a punch with it's underbarrel grenade launcher

predator.name: Drone
predator.description: A disposable tracking device that uses Yautja technology similar to the bionic mask’s scanning abilities.  After deployment, the Drone will cloak itself and send out a pulse, marking all prey within its scanning radius for a set duration.

predator.name: Motion Detector
predator.description: Throwable device that sticks to surfaces and generates a motion detection field. Prey entering this field trigger an alert and are marked

predator.name: Healing Kit

predator.name: Audio Decoy

predator.name: Bear Trap
predator.description: A proximity based trap that slightly damages and captures prey when tripped. The trap throws up an alert when it gets triggered.

fireteam.name: EMP Mine
fireteam.description: The OWLF whipped up this modified EMP mine to interact with alien tech. When triggered it will knock out a Predator’s cloak and send their whole system into overload.

fireteam.name: Self Revive Syrette
fireteam.description: Single use gear item that revives yourself when downed. This gear item cannot be resupplied and is not affected by the "Gearhead" perk.

fireteam.name: U.A.V. Scanner

fireteam.name: A.C.I.G
